findings.message: The object 26F18B5D-4584-47EC-9F5F-0E651F0452C9 at 0x135 in the Header Extension Object is none of the objects the specification defines; readers ignore it (section 3.1).
The last superframe ends with 19734 bits after its last frame that no frame uses, since no superframe follows to finish a frame begun in them; a decoder drops them.
